response.rationale: A is about scales. ScaleRepository (node 18ab235f6c31a91a, src/persistence/repositories.ts) stores ScaleRecord entries: "private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();". The methods that call it (ScaleService.linkScale, recordReading and sendAlert) suggest a weighing device that gets linked to something, records readings and sends alerts. B is about hives. HiveService (node a539722e0cf13224, src/business/hiveService.ts) creates and returns HiveRecord: "registerHive(memberId: string, apiaryId: string, name: unknown): HiveRecord {". Hives belong to an apiary and are stored through HiveRepository. A scale is probably attached to a hive, but it is a separate thing with its own lifecycle (readings and alerts). The two use different record types (ScaleRecord and HiveRecord) and different repositories, so they are related but not the same concept.
